source_text: Hands-on sand brewing class with food tasting of Turkish delicacies. Discover the centuries-old art of Turkish coffee brewed on hot sand — learn to control heat, foam, and timing to pull the perfect cezve. Along the way you'll taste Turkish delights, baklava, and gözleme paired with each brew, and leave with the technique (and confidence) to recreate the ritual at home. Approximately 2 hours, no experience needed.
translated_text: 手作沙煮咖啡课程，配土耳其美食品鉴。探索传承数百年的热沙冲泡土耳其咖啡艺术 —— 学习掌控火候、泡沫与时间，萃取出完美的 Cezve。期间您将品尝土耳其软糖、Baklava 和 Gözleme，与每一杯咖啡相得益彰，并掌握重现家中冲泡仪式的技巧与自信。时长约 2 小时，无需经验。

source_text: Roastery demo with equipment experience and coffee tasting. Step behind the bar into our roastery: watch green beans transform through the roast, listen for first crack, and compare roast profiles side by side. You'll get hands-on time with our brewing equipment — grinder calibration, espresso extraction, and milk texturing — followed by a guided tasting of the coffees you roasted. Perfect for home baristas. Approximately 2.5 hours, all equipment and beans provided.
translated_text: 烘焙工坊体验，包括设备操作和咖啡品鉴。走进吧台后的烘焙工坊：观察生豆在烘焙过程中的变化，聆听第一次爆裂声，并对比不同烘焙曲线。您将亲手操作我们的冲泡设备——磨豆机校准、意式浓缩萃取和奶泡打发——随后在指导下品尝您自己烘焙的咖啡。适合家庭咖啡师。时长约2.5小时，提供所有设备和咖啡豆。
